Caramelised Onions
By: From My Lemony ...
Published: Monday, November 1, 2010 - 8:16pm

Ingredients




Red Onion- thinly sliced
balsamic vinegar
sugar
olive oil

Preparation

1 Mix the onion with balsamic vinegar and sugar. 2 Set aside. 3 Add about 3 tablespoon of olive oil in a saucepan or wok or even on the Barbie, add onion and keep stirring until it caramelised... 4 Serve with steak or hotdog or burger
